title: ILVA IS A KILLER IT'S NOT A GAME
altText: Powerful political activism street art mural by Mr Blob in Milan on Via Dionigi Bussola, protesting against ILVA pollution with a surreal fish character, an hourglass, and industrial chimneys on puzzle pieces.
description: A protest piece against the pollution of the ILVA steel plant in Taranto, painted on Via Dionigi Bussola in Milan. The wall reads like a broken puzzle: interlocking pieces carrying smoking industrial chimneys dissolve into a golden fish skeleton, which regains its flesh as a vividly colored surreal fish on the right, an hourglass hooked at its mouth. The message painted alongside — "ILVA is a killer, it's not a game" — makes the environmental denunciation explicit.
